engineeringSkip.reason: This is a physics-flavoured buzzword mash-up — there is no real cryptographic scheme built on the holographic principle, and 'zero-intercept interstellar communication' is speculation with no engineering basis.

factCheck.reason: The holographic principle is a serious idea in quantum gravity, but it has nothing to do with cryptography, and 'quantum holographic encryption' is a mash-up of physics buzzwords describing no real cipher or research field — existing quantum-safe methods like quantum key distribution are entirely different things.
